results.name: Dual concurrent Tablo.Api workers started against PostgreSQL
First restaurant message starts 10-minute waiting period (600s)
Additional restaurant message preserves original deadline & log
Pre-deadline period sends zero escalation emails
Dual concurrent workers escalate ONCE at deadline without counting as reply
Super Admin reply ends waiting period; subsequent reply starts new period; timely reply cancels
Resolution cancels pending escalation; Reopen with message starts new period
Worker recovers stale Processing claim after simulated crash/restart
Worker pre-dispatch recheck cancels mismatched log without sending email
Transient SMTP failure records errors, retries with backoff, and succeeds on Attempt 3
Permanent SMTP failure stops strictly at MaxAttempts=5 with NextRetryAtUtc=NULL
